# Monetary Amount

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MonetaryAmount`](gmeow-MonetaryAmount.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MonetaryAmount>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

A quantity of money expressed as a decimal value in an explicit currency reference frame. The canonical superset of [schema:MonetaryAmount](https://schema.org/MonetaryAmount) and [FIBO](../../external/ontologies.md#target-fibo-fnd-pas-ps) [fibo-fnd-acc-cur:MonetaryAmount.](https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Accounting/CurrencyAmount/MonetaryAmount.) Frame-relative ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)): a value without its currency frame is ill-formed.
